'''Forthought''' was one of the two main continents on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ropagi II]], located on the eastern hemisphere.

==Description==
Like most of Ropagi II's surface, Forethought was dominated by flat plains and large urban centers. The cities [[Ebyl]], [[Torvane]] and [[Balarik]] were located here, as well as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ropagis]], the [[Great Library]], [[Arena of the Mind]] and the only starport of the planet, located in [[Off-Worlders' Quarter]]. All cities were connected by [[Monorail/Legends|monorails]] and [[skyshuttle]] systems. As the name implied, the Ropagu who oriented their thoughts towards the future lived on this continent.<ref name="Twin Stars" />
